snippet.title: Dune: Part Three - Exclusive Teaser Trailer (2026) Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Robert Pattinson
snippet.description:
From Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures comes Dune: Part Three, bringing Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Denis Villeneuve’s epic trilogy to a breathtaking conclusion.
 
Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

 The film stars Oscar nominee Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Oscar nominee Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach de Bankolé, with Oscar nominee Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Oscar winner Javier Bardem.

 Villeneuve directs from a screenplay by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, based on the novels written by Frank Herbert. The film is produced by Oscar nominees Mary Parent, Tanya Lapointe, Villeneuve, Cale Boyter and Joe Caracciolo, Jr., and executive produced by Joshua Grode, Thomas Tull, Herbert W. Gains, Brian Herbert, Byron Merritt, Kim Herbert, Kevin J. Anderson, Richard P. Rubinstein, John Harrison and Jessica Derhammer.

 Joining Villeneuve behind the camera are Oscar-winning director of photography Linus Sandgren, Oscar-winning production designer Patrice Vermette, Oscar-winning editor Joe Walker, Oscar nominated costume designer Jacqueline West, Oscar-winning visual effects supervisor Paul Lambert and visual effects supervisor Mag Sarnowska, Oscar-winning visual effects house DNEG, Oscar-nominated casting director Francine Maisler, and Oscar-winning composer Hans Zimmer.

 Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures Present A Legendary Pictures Production In Association With Image Nation Studios, A Film By Denis Villeneuve, Dune: Part Three, only in theaters and IMAX® across North America on December 18, 2026 and internationally beginning 16 December 2026. The film will be distributed worldwide by Warner Bros. Pictures and in China by Legendary East.

Avengers Doomsday Beast New Scene Breakdown & New International Teaser Explained

Entertainment Weekly just revealed our first full look at Kelsey Grammer's Beast in Avengers: Doomsday, along with 5 more official images packed with hidden details!
Plus, a new international teaser shows Steve Rogers and Thor walking straight into Doctor Doom's throne room.

In this Avengers Doomsday breakdown, we go through all 6 new Entertainment Weekly images one by one, from Beast's redesigned blue fur and older look to a frightened Magneto with an Earth behind him, Steve Rogers in what might be the TVA, Gambit and Shang-Chi in an intense ship scene, Ant-Man, Red Guardian and Johnny Storm inside the Fantastic Four's ship, and Thor raising Stormbreaker. We also break down Chris Evans revealing Marvel's Nomad pitch and Joe Russo explaining why mutants are in a constant fight for survival.

Then we go through the new international teaser, from Doom's throne room and Johnny Storm's first flame on to the Thing's full jump and the rumored Hulk vs Thing fight, Cyclops blasting a Sentinel, the updated incursion outside Professor X's window, the heroes gathering inside Steve Rogers' house, Mjolnir flying to Steve right in front of Thor, and Steve and Thor confronting Doctor Doom.
